title: Deka 4-ku: Tough the Truck
native_title: デカ４駆 ～タフ・ザ・トラック～
overview:
Watch Out for Motion Sickness?!

The 4WD vehicles that are so popular right now arrive on the Sega Saturn as a full-fledged racing game!

Get behind the wheel of a hulking four-wheel-drive truck and race rival drivers over rough off-road courses. Steep forest trails, desert tracks and snowy roads throw your truck up and down hills, and each vehicle's independent suspension reacts to every bump, so you feel the terrain as you charge toward the finish line. Switch camera views to get closer to the action while a commentator calls the race.

- A lineup of distinctive 4WD trucks with their own handling
- Six courses across forest, desert and snow
- Realistic vehicle behavior and road surfaces

乗り物酔い注意?!

いま人気の4WDが本格レースゲームとして、セガサターンに登場!
